veg.make_ahead: Boil the eggs up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Wash the cos lettuces, dry well and tear into a large platter.
Cut the smoked tofu into thin strips and slice the avocado.
Arrange the smoked tofu, swiss cheese strips, avocado, halved eggs, tomatoes and cucumber in rows over the lettuce.
Pour the olive oil and red wine vinegar into two little jugs and serve them on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Roast and slice the beetroot up to 2 days ahead, sear to serve

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast at 200C until a knife slides in easily.
Cool the beetroot a little, rub off the skins and slice as thin as you can.
Mix the olive oil, cracked black pepper, ground coriander, smoked paprika, brown sugar and red wine vinegar, toss the beetroot through and sear in a hot pan until sticky at the edges.
Spread the rye with mustard.
Pile the beetroot high on four slices and close the sandwiches.
Serve each with a pickle on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Roast the portobellos and make the filling up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; wrap, brush with egg and bake on the night

steps.text: Chop the button mushrooms very fine and crush the garlic.
Brush the portobello mushrooms with some of the olive oil, season with salt and pepper and roast at 200C for 15 minutes, then brush with the mustard and cool.
Cook the chopped mushrooms with the garlic and thyme in the rest of the oil until dry.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan and squeeze out the water.
Lay the spinach on a pastry sheet, spread with the mushroom mix and stack the portobellos in a log on top. Wrap, seal with the second sheet and brush with egg.
Bake at 210C until deep golden.
Rest before slicing.

veg.make_ahead: Gravy with the soy up to 2 days ahead in the fridge, reheated on the night; boil, rice and beat the potatoes fresh

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft.
Cook the onions slowly in some of the butter until golden.
Stir in the flour, add the vegetable stock and soy sauce and simmer for gravy.
Rice the potatoes and beat with the hot milk and the rest of the butter.
Pile into a tall mountain and pour the gravy over.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 1cm slices, sprinkle with the salt, leave for 10 minutes and pat dry.
Dust in flour, dip in beaten egg and press into crushed crackers mixed with panko.
Shallow fry in the vegetable oil at 180C until golden each side and soft in the middle.
Toss shredded cabbage with mayonnaise and vinegar.
Serve in soft buns with mustard, mayo, pickles and sliced onion and the slaw on the side.

veg.n: Mac and cheese with butter-poached king oyster mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake to serve

steps.text: Boil the macaroni and drain well. Cut the king oyster mushrooms into thick coins.
Gently cook the mushrooms in some of the butter with the paprika until tender, then squeeze over the lemon.
Melt more butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the warm milk and simmer. Stir in the Gruyere and cheddar.
Fold through the macaroni and mushrooms and tip into a baking dish.
Top with the panko mixed with the rest of the butter, melted, and bake at 200C until golden.
Bring the water to the boil with the gochugaru, the soy and the vegetable stock cube.
Cook the ramen noodles for 3 minutes, leaving out the flavour sachets, crack in the eggs and cover 1 minute.
Divide into bowls with the kimchi, sliced spring onions and a slice of cheese melting on top.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day for the sauce, fry chips fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Fry the fries twice in the vegetable oil until crisp, then salt.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, brown in the olive oil in a hot pan, then roast at 200C until tender.
Toast the cracked peppercorns in the pan, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve the cauliflower steaks with the fries, sauce and a green salad.

veg.make_ahead: Celeriac can be simmered 1 day ahead, keep chilled in its liquid

steps.text: Peel the onion, celeriacs, potatoes and carrots. Cut each celeriac into 4 thick slabs, cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks and quarter the cabbage.
Fill a large pot with water and add the onion, bay leaves, peppercorns, cloves, brown sugar, malt vinegar and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the celeriac and simmer gently.
Add the potatoes and carrots and keep simmering, adding the cabbage for the last 10 minutes.
Melt half the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Stir in the parsley.
Lift out the celeriac and brown it in the rest of the butter in a hot pan.
Serve the celeriac with the vegetables, parsley sauce and mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the cauliflowers up to 1 day ahead, roast fresh

ingredients.item: garlic clove, crushed, for the yoghurt
mixed vegetables for roasting (pumpkin, zucchini, red onion)

steps.text: Trim the cauliflowers, keeping them whole, and rub with the garlic, rosemary, paprika, most of the oil and the salt.
Roast covered at 200C until a knife goes in with little resistance.
Uncover, add the vegetables and chickpeas tossed in the rest of the oil, and roast until the cauliflower is charred and the chickpeas are crisp.
Stir the garlic into the yoghurt.
Warm the flatbreads and pull the cauliflower apart at the table.

veg.n: Mullins family nut roast and gravy
veg.make_ahead: Press the nut roast mix into the tin up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; roast on the night and add 10 minutes

steps.text: Cook the onion, garlic and mushrooms in a little of the oil until soft and dry.
Chop the walnuts fine and mix with the mushrooms, lentils, breadcrumbs, eggs, cheddar, thyme and mustard. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Parboil the potatoes, drain, rough up and toss in the rest of the oil.
Roast the nut roast and the potatoes at 200C.
Toss the carrots in the honey and add for the last 25 minutes of roasting.
Rest the nut roast in the tin before turning out and slicing.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer to a gravy.

veg.n: Mama Boucher's mushroom and sausage gumbo (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Gumbo up to 2 days ahead, reheat gently with a splash of stock; cook the rice and add fresh spring onion on the night

steps.text: Stir the flour into the oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat until the roux turns dark brown like chocolate.
Brown the mushrooms and vegetarian sausages in the extra oil in a frying pan.
Add the onion, celery and capsicum to the roux and cook until soft.
Add the mushrooms, sausages, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika and stock. Simmer.
Add the okra and cook until tender. Meanwhile steam the rice.
Serve over rice with spring onion and hot sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Cook the vegetarian sausages slowly over low coals or a barbecue, turning often, until browned all over.
Fry the onions in the butter on the hotplate until soft and golden.
Fold each sausage into bread with onions and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled, flavour improves

ingredients.item: portobello and Swiss brown mushrooms, cut into big chunks

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C. Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and brown in batches in the oil in a heavy ovenproof pot.
Soften the sliced onions and chopped carrots in the same pot, then stir in the tomato paste and flour.
Return the mushrooms, add the lentils, ale, stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven until thick and rich.
Serve with the crusty bread for mopping up.

veg_af.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled, flavour improves

ingredients.item: portobello and Swiss brown mushrooms, cut into big chunks

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C. Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and brown in batches in the oil in a heavy ovenproof pot.
Soften the sliced onions and chopped carrots in the same pot, then stir in the tomato paste and flour.
Return the mushrooms, add the lentils, all the stock, the malt vinegar and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven until thick and rich.
Serve with the crusty bread for mopping up.

veg.n: Pie machine mushroom and onion pies
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days, bake fresh

steps.text: Chop the mushrooms and slice the onions.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, add the onions, thyme, tomato paste, soy sauce, lentils and stock, cover and simmer.
Thicken with cornflour mixed in water, then cool.
Line four pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff and egg wash.
Bake at 200C.
Simmer the peas with the butter and mash roughly.

veg.n: Erick's roast celeriac with caramelised potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Roast the celeriacs up to 1 day ahead and reheat in a 200C oven; glaze the potatoes, make the gravy and cook the peas on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel the celeriacs, rub with the oil, salt, pepper, thyme and crushed garlic cloves, wrap in foil and roast for 90 minutes. Unwrap and roast 30 minutes more, basting with a little of the butter.
Boil the baby potatoes until tender and peel.
Melt the sugar in a pan until golden, add some of the butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed.
Melt a knob of the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour, then add the red wine, stock and soy sauce and simmer to a gravy.
Cook the peas, toss with the last of the butter and serve with the celeriac carved into thick slices.

veg_af.n: Erick's roast celeriac with caramelised potatoes
veg_af.make_ahead: Wrap and roast the celeriacs up to 1 day ahead and keep them covered; reheat, then glaze the potatoes and make the gravy and peas fresh

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel the celeriacs, rub with the oil, salt, pepper, thyme and crushed garlic cloves, wrap in foil and roast for 90 minutes. Unwrap and roast 30 minutes more, basting with a little of the butter.
Boil the baby potatoes until tender and peel.
Melt the sugar in a pan until golden, add some of the butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed.
Melt a knob of the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour, then add all the stock, the red wine vinegar and soy sauce and simmer to a gravy.
Cook the peas, toss with the last of the butter and serve with the celeriac carved into thick slices.

veg.n: Grimmauld Place mushroom and kidney bean pie
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake just before serving

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms into big chunks and drain the kidney beans.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onion.
Stir in the flour, stock and soy sauce, then add the mushrooms and kidney beans.
Simmer until thick.
Spoon into a pie dish, cool slightly and cover with the pastry.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the sauce up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled; roll the plant-based mince up to 1 day ahead and fry the chips and patties fresh

steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise, relish and mustard for the sauce. Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry the chips in the oil at 140C, then again at 185C until crisp, and salt.
Roll the plant-based mince into eight balls and smash thin on a smoking, lightly oiled griddle.
Top with cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the tofu in the fridge up to 1 day ahead; grill or pan fry on the night

steps.text: Press the tofu between paper towel and cut into thick slabs. Mix the soy, honey, vegetable stock and sugar and pour over the tofu.
Marinate in the fridge.
Lift out the tofu, dust with cornflour and grill or pan fry in the oil until charred and crisp.
Reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Cook the rice and steam the bok choy.

veg.make_ahead: Congee up to 2 days, add mushrooms and tofu when reheating

steps.text: Bruise the lemongrass and slice the ginger.
Simmer the rice in the stock with the lemongrass and ginger, stirring often, until creamy.
Slice the shiitake mushrooms and cut the tofu into cubes.
Add the mushrooms, tofu, bamboo shoots and soy sauce for the last few minutes.
Top with chilli and a pinch of sugar.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Fry the chickpeas in a little of the oil with the smoked paprika until crisp, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the rest of the oil until golden, seasoning with salt.
Stir in the tomato paste, then pour in the wine and the stock.
Simmer until rich and glossy, stirring the chickpeas back in for the last 5 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the mushrooms.
Fry the chickpeas in a little of the oil with the smoked paprika until crisp, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the rest of the oil until golden, seasoning with salt.
Stir in the tomato paste, then pour in all the stock, the grape juice and the red wine vinegar.
Simmer until rich and glossy, stirring the chickpeas back in for the last 5 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the eggplant and mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; flour, fry and make the sauce just before serving

steps.text: Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 1cm slices.
Dust the eggplant in seasoned flour and fry in batches in the butter and oil for 3 to 4 minutes a side until golden and soft, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms, add the marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the eggplant and warm through.

veg_af.make_ahead: Slice the eggplant and mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; flour, fry and make the grape juice sauce just before serving

steps.text: Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 1cm slices.
Dust the eggplant in seasoned flour and fry in batches in the butter and oil for 3 to 4 minutes a side until golden and soft, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms, add the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the eggplant and warm through.

veg.n: Hallorann's garlic and rosemary roast pumpkin
veg.make_ahead: Stud and rub the pumpkins up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast, add the lentils and make the gravy on the day

steps.text: Halve the pumpkins lengthwise, scoop out the seeds and score the flesh. Stud with the garlic and rosemary and rub with the oil, salt and pepper.
Roast at 200C with the potatoes around them.
Spoon the lentils into the hollows, crumble over the feta and roast 10 minutes more.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer for gravy.
Cut the pumpkin into thick slices and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Halve the corn and mushrooms and slice the haloumi up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; cook it all on the night

steps.text: Halve the corn, crush the garlic, halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthwise and cut the haloumi into thick slices.
Boil the potatoes in a big pot.
Add the corn, wine, garlic and butter, then the mushrooms. Cover and steam.
Meanwhile sear the haloumi in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Tip it all onto the table with the haloumi and lemon wedges.

veg_af.make_ahead: Halve the corn and mushrooms and slice the haloumi up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; cook it all on the night

steps.text: Halve the corn, crush the garlic, halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthwise and cut the haloumi into thick slices.
Boil the potatoes in a big pot.
Add the corn, stock, vinegar, garlic and butter, then the mushrooms. Cover and steam.
Meanwhile sear the haloumi in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Tip it all onto the table with the haloumi and lemon wedges.

veg.n: North Pole Christmas mushroom and chestnut roll
veg.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 1 day ahead; roll the log up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled, and roast on the day

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms, onion, sage and smoked paprika in half the oil until dry.
Mix with the breadcrumbs, lentils, chopped chestnuts and most of the egg, then cool.
Lay the two pastry sheets slightly overlapping, spoon the filling along one edge, roll into a log and seal. Brush with the rest of the egg.
Roast the potatoes in the rest of the oil at 200C, adding the log for the last 40 minutes.
Rest the log and roast the brussels sprouts.
Serve sliced with sprouts and cranberry sauce.

veg.n: Prom dinner haloumi with mushroom cream
veg.make_ahead: Slice the haloumi and mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; mash, sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with some of the butter.
Sear the haloumi in a little of the butter until golden on both sides, then keep warm.
Fry the mushrooms in the pan, add the wine and cream and reduce to a sauce.
Steam the beans and toss with butter.

veg_af.n: Prom dinner haloumi with mushroom cream
veg_af.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and cut the haloumi up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; mash, sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with some of the butter.
Sear the haloumi in a little of the butter until golden on both sides, then keep warm.
Fry the mushrooms in the pan, add the stock, vinegar and cream and reduce to a sauce.
Steam the beans and toss with butter.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Soak the noodles in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Fry the tofu and garlic in the oil, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles, tamarind, soy sauce and brown sugar and toss until the noodles are tender.
Finish with bean sprouts, peanuts and a squeeze of lime.

veg.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead and reheat; hollow and roast the pumpkins on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until browned, then stir in the chilli powder.
Add the tomatoes, lentils and beans and simmer until thick.
Hollow the pumpkins.
Roast the pumpkins at 200C.
Fill with chilli, sour cream and cheddar.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches. Add the onions and paprika and stir for a minute.
Add the tomatoes, capsicum, butter beans and stock.
Simmer until thick and rich.
Cook the noodles, toss with butter and serve the goulash over the top.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets, steam for 3 minutes and dry well.
Dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, then press into the panko mixed with coconut.
Fry in oil at 180C in batches until golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

veg.n: Style Boyz haloumi tacos with mango salsa
veg.make_ahead: Make the mango salsa and shred the cabbage up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; blend the crema and grill the haloumi on the night

steps.text: Rub the haloumi with the chilli powder, cumin, lime zest and oil.
Grill the haloumi, turning once, until golden, then cut into strips.
Toss the mango, onion, chilli, lime juice and coriander for the salsa.
Blend the avocado with the sour cream and lime juice into a crema.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with cabbage, haloumi, salsa and crema.

veg.make_ahead: Press the mushroom clusters and make the mash up to 1 day ahead; dredge, fry and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter and some of the milk. Keep warm.
Press the mushroom clusters flat with your hand and season the flour with salt and plenty of cracked peppercorns.
Dredge each cluster in flour, then buttermilk, then flour again.
Shallow fry in hot oil until deep golden and crisp, then keep warm on a rack.
Whisk the gravy flour into a little of the pan oil, add the remaining milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer until thick.
Serve the mushrooms over the mash with the gravy.

veg.n: Mudka's Meat Hut black bean cheeseburger and chips
veg.make_ahead: Mash and shape the black bean patties up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; fry the chips and grill the patties on the night

steps.text: Fry the potato chips in the oil once at a gentle heat until soft, then again hot until crisp.
Mash the black beans roughly with the breadcrumbs, egg, cumin and smoked paprika and shape into 4 patties.
Cook the patties on a hot, lightly oiled grill plate until crusty on both sides.
Melt the cheddar on top and grill the onion.
Serve on toasted buns with pickles. Special for two, or four.

veg.make_ahead: Press and glaze the tofu up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast it and boil the potatoes on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, brush with the oil and season with salt and pepper. Mix the maple syrup and mustard and brush over the tofu.
Roast the tofu at 200C until golden at the edges. While it roasts, boil the potatoes.
Steam the green beans, then toss with the potatoes and butter.
Serve everything together.

veg.n: Smoky mushrooms and scrambled eggs on toast
veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat until browned, then add the smoked paprika, soy sauce and maple syrup and cook until sticky.
Whisk the eggs with salt and scramble slowly in some of the butter until soft.
Toast and butter the bread.
Pile everything onto plates with a square of dark chocolate on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Make the tarragon butter up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Trim the cauliflower, keep it whole and boil for 8 minutes. Drain and dry well.
Mix the softened butter with chopped tarragon and the flaky salt and spread it all over the cauliflower, pushing it between the florets.
Roast at 220C with the halved potatoes tossed in the oil, basting the cauliflower now and then, until deep golden.
Whisk the flour into the tray juices, add the stock and simmer to a gravy.
Cook the peas and toss with butter.

veg.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the chillies, cumin, crushed garlic, tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer until thick.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, buttermilk and egg into cornbread batter.
Bake the cornbread at 200C alongside.
Serve the chilli with cornbread.

veg.make_ahead: Make the glaze up to 3 days ahead, chilled, and score the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead; cook on the night

ingredients.item: large eggplants, halved lengthwise and scored

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Cook the rice.
Brush the eggplant with the oil and cook cut side down in a hot pan for 6 minutes, then turn and cook until soft right through, brushing with glaze in the last few minutes.
Slice, and blanch the bok choy to serve alongside.

veg_af.make_ahead: Make the apple juice glaze up to 3 days ahead, chilled, and score the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead; cook on the night

ingredients.item: large eggplants, halved lengthwise and scored

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice, water, rice vinegar and sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Cook the rice.
Brush the eggplant with the oil and cook cut side down in a hot pan for 6 minutes, then turn and cook until soft right through, brushing with glaze in the last few minutes.
Slice, and blanch the bok choy to serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 1 day ahead in cold water in the fridge and wipe the mushrooms; roast, sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C.
Sear the mushrooms hard in the butter, gill side up first, then turn and cook until tender. Set aside.
Deglaze the pan with bourbon and the crushed black peppercorns.
Add the stock and cream and reduce.
Serve the mushrooms with potatoes and sauce.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the potatoes up to 1 day ahead in cold water in the fridge and wipe the mushrooms; roast, sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C.
Sear the mushrooms hard in the butter, gill side up first, then turn and cook until tender. Set aside.
Deglaze the pan with the apple juice, cider vinegar and crushed black peppercorns.
Add the stock and cream and reduce.
Serve the mushrooms with potatoes and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Halve the mushrooms and slice the haloumi and sausages up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; boil, steam and sear on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Meanwhile halve the mushrooms lengthwise and cut the haloumi into thick slices.
Add the corn, vegetarian sausages, butter and a splash of water.
Add the mushrooms, cover and steam for 8 minutes.
Sear the haloumi in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Tip it all onto the table with the haloumi on top.

veg.make_ahead: Press the nut roast mix into the tin up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; make the batter up to 1 day ahead. Roast the nut roast, potatoes and puddings on the night

steps.text: Cook the onion and mushrooms in the olive oil until soft and dry.
Chop the cashews fine and mix with the mushrooms, lentils, breadcrumbs, thyme and 2 eggs. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Whisk the batter flour, the other 3 eggs and the milk into a batter and rest.
Peel and chop the potatoes.

Roast the nut roast and the potatoes in most of the vegetable oil at 200C. When the nut roast comes out to rest, pour the batter into muffin tins heated with the rest of the oil and bake until puffed.
Cook the peas.
Melt the butter, whisk in the gravy flour, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer to a gravy.

veg.n: Geppetto's spaghetti and mushroom ricotta meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days

ingredients.item: vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, grated, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in a little of the oil until all the liquid is gone, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the ricotta, breadcrumbs, vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, parsley, salt and egg and roll into balls.
Bake the meatballs on an oiled tray at 200C until browned.
Simmer the tomatoes, garlic and basil in the rest of the oil, adding the meatballs for the last 10 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti.
Serve with extra cheese on top.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day

steps.text: Peel the celeriacs and brown hard on all sides in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots, celery, stock, soy sauce and thyme. Cover and braise at 180C for 45 minutes.
Add the potatoes and braise until everything is tender.
Lift out the celeriac and veg. Thicken the juices with the flour into gravy and carve the celeriac into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Mix and shape the lentil loaf up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; bake, mash and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry.
Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk, then mix with the lentils, roughly mashed, the mushrooms, egg, cheddar, soy sauce and smoked paprika.
Shape into a loaf on a lined tray.
Bake at 180C for 35 minutes, then brush with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake again.
Boil the potatoes and mash with most of the butter and the rest of the milk.
Melt the last of the butter in a pan, whisk in the flour, add the stock and simmer to a gravy.

veg.n: Sliders and mac and cheese party plate (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Bake the mac and cheese cups up to 1 day ahead, cover in the fridge and reheat; cook the plant-based patties just before serving

steps.text: Cook the macaroni until just tender and drain.
Mix the macaroni with the tasty cheese and milk and spoon into greased muffin tins.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Shape the plant-based mince into small patties and cook in the oil on both sides, topping with cheddar to melt.
Serve in slider buns with pickles alongside the mac and cheese cups.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks and mash the garlic butter up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; roast, sear and steam on the night

steps.text: Halve the potatoes, toss in most of the oil and roast at 220C.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower and sear hard in the rest of the oil.
Finish the cauliflower in the oven with the potatoes until tender.
Steam the beans and top the cauliflower steaks with garlic butter.

veg.n: The mushroom steak, not the fish
veg.make_ahead: Boil and mash the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and reheat with a splash of milk; sear the mushrooms on the night

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes.
Sear the mushrooms in the oil until tender and set aside.
Crush the peppercorns into the pan, add the cream and reduce until thick.
Mash the potatoes with butter and milk and steam the beans.
Serve on trays, airline style.

veg.n: Joi's cauliflower steak, mash and red wine jus
veg.make_ahead: Mash the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and reheat; make the jus up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; sear and roast the cauliflower on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes and mash with most of the butter.
Reduce the red wine with the stock and soy sauce into a jus, then whisk in the rest of the butter.
Cut two thick steaks from each cauliflower, sear hard in the oil, then roast at 200C until tender.
Steam the green beans.
Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.

veg_af.n: Joi's cauliflower steak, mash and red wine jus
veg_af.make_ahead: Mash the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and reheat; make the grape juice jus up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; sear and roast the cauliflower on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes and mash with most of the butter.
Reduce the grape juice and red wine vinegar with the stock and soy sauce into a jus, then whisk in the rest of the butter.
Cut two thick steaks from each cauliflower, sear hard in the oil, then roast at 200C until tender.
Steam the green beans.
Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the onions up to 1 day ahead, chilled; grill the mushrooms and haloumi and build on the night

steps.text: Fry the sliced onions in half the oil until golden.
Sear the mushrooms in the rest of the oil on a hot grill until tender, and grill the haloumi until golden.
Melt a slice of cheddar on each mushroom.
Toast the buns and stack with haloumi, mushroom, onions and barbecue sauce.

veg.n: War Rig barbecue haloumi and eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Marinate the eggplant and haloumi for 30 minutes with the chopped rosemary, the crushed garlic cloves, the juice of the lemon and the oil.
Grill the eggplant over high heat until soft and charred, then grill the haloumi 2 minutes a side.
Grill the corn cobs alongside and brush with butter.

veg.make_ahead: Curry keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Mix the paneer with half the yoghurt, the ginger, garlic and garam masala.
Marinate in the fridge.
Cook the onions slowly in oil until deep brown.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and stock and simmer until thick.
Stir in the paneer with its marinade and the rest of the yoghurt and simmer gently.
Cook the rice, season the curry with salt and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Roll the lentil balls up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; simmer in the tomatoes up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently. Cook the spaghetti just before serving

ingredients.item: vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, grated, for the meatballs
vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, grated, to serve

steps.text: Soak the bread in the milk, then mash with the lentils, walnuts, vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, parsley and egg.
Roll into balls and chill for a few minutes to firm up.
Brown the meatballs gently in the oil.
Simmer in the tomatoes.
Cook the spaghetti.
Toss with the sauce and the vegetarian parmesan-style cheese to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 days ahead and reheat

ingredients.item: young green jackfruit in brine (2 tins), drained

steps.text: Cut the hard core from the jackfruit and pull the pieces apart with two forks.
Toss with the onion, oil, salt, pepper and paprika.
Roast at 200C until browned at the edges.
Stir through half the barbecue sauce and roast again until sticky.
Serve piled on white bread with pickles and the rest of the barbecue sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the mushrooms and mix the sauces up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Stretch the dough into two rounds on trays oiled with half the oil.
Fry the mushrooms in the rest of the oil with the smoked paprika until browned.
Mix the pizza sauce with the barbecue sauce and spread over the bases. Scatter with mozzarella.
Top with the mushrooms, smoked tofu and vegetarian sausages cut into small pieces.
Bake at 240C until the crust is golden and the toppings are crisp.

veg.make_ahead: Grate the mozzarella and slice the plant-based pepperoni up to 1 day ahead; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Stretch the dough thin on a tray dusted with the plain flour.
Spread with pizza sauce and scatter with mozzarella, plant-based pepperoni and oregano.
Bake on a very hot tray at 250C.
Cut into big slices and fold each in half to eat.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions, carrots and thyme and soften.
Add the ale, stock, potatoes and butter beans.
Simmer covered until the potatoes are tender.

veg_af.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions, carrots and thyme and soften.
Add all the stock, the malt vinegar, potatoes and butter beans.
Simmer covered until the potatoes are tender.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lemon thyme butter up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Trim the cauliflower, keep it whole and boil for 8 minutes, then drain and dry well.
Mix the butter with lemon zest, thyme leaves and the salt and spread it all over the cauliflower, pushing it between the florets.
Roast at 200C with the potatoes and the halved lemon tossed in the oil.
Add the cannellini beans to the tray and roast until the cauliflower is deep golden.
Cut into wedges and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the onion in the lime juice up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; make the slaw and crema up to 1 day ahead, fry the banana blossom on the night

ingredients.item: banana blossom in brine (2 tins), drained

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt.
Pat the banana blossom dry and pull into bite-sized pieces. Crumble the nori.
Whisk most of the flour, the nori, baking powder and lager to a batter.
Dust the banana blossom in the rest of the flour, dip in batter and fry in the oil at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix the sour cream with the chipotle sauce.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, banana blossom, crema, onion and coriander.

veg_af.make_ahead: Soak the onion and mix the crema up to 1 day ahead; whisk the batter and fry the banana blossom just before serving so the sparkling water stays lively

ingredients.item: banana blossom in brine (2 tins), drained

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt.
Pat the banana blossom dry and pull into bite-sized pieces. Crumble the nori.
Whisk most of the flour, the nori, baking powder and sparkling water to a batter.
Dust the banana blossom in the rest of the flour, dip in batter and fry in the oil at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix the sour cream with the chipotle sauce.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, banana blossom, crema, onion and coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in a hot pan

steps.text: Dice the potatoes, onion and smoked tofu.
Boil the potatoes, then drain well.
Fry the onion in butter and oil.
Add the potatoes and tofu and press flat.
Cook over medium-high heat, turning in sections, until crusty.
Splash with soy sauce and add chopped parsley.
Fry the eggs and sit one on each serve with brown sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge and shape the plant-based patties up to 4 hours ahead; cook and build fresh

steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise, relish, mustard, paprika and vinegar for the sauce.
Shape the plant-based mince into 8 thin patties.
Smash the patties in a hot pan with the oil and add the cheese.
Toast the buns.
Build each with sauce, lettuce, onion, pickles and patties in the three-piece bun.

veg.n: Mushroom steak sandwich and a mushroom steak sandwich
veg.make_ahead: Caramelise the onions up to 2 days ahead and reheat; sear the mushrooms and build the rolls on the night

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in the butter and sugar until jammy.
Season the mushrooms, brush with the oil and sear in a very hot pan, pressing down, until tender.
Lay the cheese on the mushrooms and cover briefly to melt.
Toast the rolls. Mix the mayonnaise with the mustard.
Build each roll with mayo, rocket, tomato, mushrooms and onions, then cut in half so everyone has two.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the plant-based patties and mix the burger sauce up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; grill on the night

steps.text: Shape the plant-based mince into patties slightly wider than the buns, season well and brush with the oil.
Grill on a hot barbecue 4 minutes a side, adding the slices of American cheese for the last minute.
Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped dill pickles.
Toast the sesame buns, spread with sauce, add shredded lettuce, the patty and sliced pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Rest 10 minutes before carving

steps.text: Peel the celeriac, rub with the oil and salt, then spread with the softened butter mixed with the tarragon.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then drop to 180C and roast until tender, basting with the tarragon butter.
Rest and carve into thick slices.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter for the mash until silky.
Whisk the dressing oil, mustard and vinegar and toss through the leaves.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat covered

steps.text: Press the tofu dry and cut into 3cm cubes.
Toss with the cornflour, oil, smoked paprika and salt.
Roast at 200C until crisp.
Toss with barbecue sauce and brown sugar.
Return to the oven until sticky.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the juice of one lemon, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil and coat the haloumi and zucchini.
Marinate for 30 minutes.
Cook the brown rice.
Grill the zucchini and haloumi over high heat until charred.
Steam the broccoli florets.
Serve with an extra squeeze of lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom gravy up to 2 days ahead and reheat until very hot; bake the chips and assemble on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter and cook the mushrooms until browned, then stir in the flour and cook until nutty.
Whisk in the stock, soy sauce and pepper and simmer until glossy.
Tear the cheese into pieces. Pile the hot chips into bowls, scatter the cheese over and pour the very hot gravy on top.

veg.n: Bell tower mushroom and bean braise
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Halve the mushrooms and peel the baby onions.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil with the smoked paprika.
Add the onions and colour lightly.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then add the stock, soy sauce, vinegar, thyme, bay leaves and butter beans.
Cover and simmer gently until the onions are tender and the sauce is rich.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and warm milk.
Serve the braise over the mash.

veg.n: Karamitsos family lemon and oregano eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Score and rub the eggplants up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast on the night and crumble over the feta at the end

steps.text: Score the cut sides of the eggplants deeply and rub with the lemon juice, garlic, oregano, most of the oil and the salt.
Roast at 180C with the potato wedges tossed in the rest of the oil, covered for the first 30 minutes.
Uncover, scatter the chickpeas around and roast until everything is browned.
Crumble the feta over and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom gravy up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and reheat; cut the chips up to 4 hours ahead in cold water and fry them fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry at 140C in the oil until soft and pale.
Cook the mushrooms in the butter until browned, stir in the flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp.
Pile chips into bowls, scatter the cheese curds and pour the hot gravy over.
